summaries.zh: DSH opens its settings in a centered 800×800 dialog. This plugin renders the same settings surface as a full-page screen instead: the panel fills the window, the category rail is wider and separated by a hairline, the content column is capped at 880px so rows stay readable, and the close control becomes one row at the top left — the arrow and the title share a single hover surface, so clicking either goes back. It patches no official file: the stylesheet is anchored on the product's own `data-sh
